rows.value: MRC-IEU UK Biobank GWAS pipeline (OpenGWAS ukb-b)
rows.quote: For validation, we used the FinnGen_L12_PSORIASIS dataset, comprising 10,312 cases and 397,564 controls, as well as the UKB-b-10,537 dataset, which includes 5341 cases and 457,619 controls.
rows.coder_note: Decision order step 2: the sentence gives the OpenGWAS accession UKB-b-10,537 (ukb-b-10537), whose prefix ukb-b only the MRC-IEU row lists. Rule C4 case 1 (prefix listed by a dictionary row, nothing conflicts): the stated 5341 cases + 457,619 controls = 462,960 is a trait-specific N within the row's 463,005 and exactly identifies no other release (rule H); no ancestry is stated; Table 1 (p003) gives the same accession with 534/457,619, a discrepancy in the case count that points to no other row.
